dataset_spec.name: uci_ilpd
dataset_spec.description: UCI Indian Liver Patient Dataset (583 observations, 10 predictors).
dataset_spec.setting: Adult from north-east Andhra Pradesh, India (Indian Liver Patient Dataset), whose record was assigned by clinicians either to the liver-patient group or to the non-liver-patient group. The observations are age, sex and routine liver function tests; ages above 89 are recorded as 90.

liver_disease.question: Based on these demographics and liver function tests, was this person in the liver-disease patient group?
